description: Tier 2 diagnostic. Is the fleet compliant, and is the compliance figure trustworthy? Live posture first, then where non-compliance sits, then the client population and the assessment history.

panels.description: Share of endpoints with a live posture result that ISE considers compliant. The headline compliance number — but read it beside the assessment coverage stat, because it only counts endpoints that were assessed at all.

defaults.noValue: no data — stale, see Collection pipeline

targets.expr: (sum((ise3_posture_endpoints{status=~"Compliant|compliant"}) and on() (((max(ise3_dataset_up{dataset="posture_current"} and on(dataset,provider) (ise3_dataset_provider_active{dataset="posture_current"} == 1))) == 1) and ((max(ise3_dataset_fresh{dataset="posture_current"} and on(dataset,provider) (ise3_dataset_provider_active{dataset="posture_current"} == 1))) == 1)))) / clamp_min((sum((ise3_posture_endpoints) and on() (((max(ise3_dataset_up{dataset="posture_current"} and on(dataset,provider) (ise3_dataset_provider_active{dataset="posture_current"} == 1))) == 1) and ((max(ise3_dataset_fresh{dataset="posture_current"} and on(dataset,provider) (ise3_dataset_provider_active{dataset="posture_current"} == 1))) == 1)))), 1)

panels.title: Compliant share

panels.description: Endpoints currently connected with a posture status that is not compliant. These are the ones sitting in a quarantine or remediation authorization profile right now.

defaults.noValue: no data — stale, see Collection pipeline

targets.expr: sum((ise3_posture_endpoints{status!~"Compliant|compliant"}) and on() (((max(ise3_dataset_up{dataset="posture_current"} and on(dataset,provider) (ise3_dataset_provider_active{dataset="posture_current"} == 1))) == 1) and ((max(ise3_dataset_fresh{dataset="posture_current"} and on(dataset,provider) (ise3_dataset_provider_active{dataset="posture_current"} == 1))) == 1)))

panels.title: Non-compliant endpoints

panels.description: Endpoints eligible for posture that have no recent assessment at all. The most under-read number in posture reporting: these are not compliant and not non-compliant, they are invisible, and the compliant share above excludes them.

defaults.noValue: no data — stale, see Collection pipeline

targets.expr: (ise3_posture_eligible_without_recent_assessment_total) and on() (((max(ise3_dataset_up{dataset="posture_history"} and on(dataset,provider) (ise3_dataset_provider_active{dataset="posture_history"} == 1))) == 1) and ((max(ise3_dataset_fresh{dataset="posture_history"} and on(dataset,provider) (ise3_dataset_provider_active{dataset="posture_history"} == 1))) == 1))

panels.title: Eligible but unassessed

panels.description: Share of posture-eligible endpoints that were actually assessed recently. This is the denominator honesty check for the compliant share: low coverage makes a high compliance figure meaningless.

defaults.noValue: no data — stale, see Collection pipeline

targets.expr: ((ise3_posture_eligible_recently_assessed_total) and on() (((max(ise3_dataset_up{dataset="posture_history"} and on(dataset,provider) (ise3_dataset_provider_active{dataset="posture_history"} == 1))) == 1) and ((max(ise3_dataset_fresh{dataset="posture_history"} and on(dataset,provider) (ise3_dataset_provider_active{dataset="posture_history"} == 1))) == 1))) / clamp_min(((ise3_posture_eligible_endpoints_total) and on() (((max(ise3_dataset_up{dataset="posture_history"} and on(dataset,provider) (ise3_dataset_provider_active{dataset="posture_history"} == 1))) == 1) and ((max(ise3_dataset_fresh{dataset="posture_history"} and on(dataset,provider) (ise3_dataset_provider_active{dataset="posture_history"} == 1))) == 1))), 1)

panels.title: Assessment coverage

panels.description: Share of this dashboard's own datasets that both collected successfully and are inside their freshness window (posture_current, posture_history). Below 100% means some panel here is blank or stale, and the pipeline dashboard says which.

targets.expr: avg(((max by (dataset) (ise3_dataset_up{dataset=~"posture_current|posture_history"} and on(dataset,provider) (ise3_dataset_provider_active{dataset=~"posture_current|posture_history"} == 1))) == bool 1) * ((max by (dataset) (ise3_dataset_fresh{dataset=~"posture_current|posture_history"} and on(dataset,provider) (ise3_dataset_provider_active{dataset=~"posture_current|posture_history"} == 1))) == bool 1))

panels.title: Data trustworthy

panels.description: Time since the least recently collected of this dashboard's datasets last succeeded. Every number on this page is at least this old; a value climbing past its collection interval means ISE is answering slowly or not at all.

targets.expr: max(time() - (max by (dataset) (ise3_dataset_last_success_timestamp{dataset=~"posture_current|posture_history"} and on(dataset,provider) (ise3_dataset_provider_active{dataset=~"posture_current|posture_history"} == 1))))

panels.title: Collection age

panels.description: Live posture status of connected endpoints, stacked because the statuses together are the whole assessed population. A widening non-compliant band without a matching drop in compliant usually means new endpoints arrived unassessed.

targets.expr: sum by (status) ((ise3_posture_endpoints) and on() (((max(ise3_dataset_up{dataset="posture_current"} and on(dataset,provider) (ise3_dataset_provider_active{dataset="posture_current"} == 1))) == 1) and ((max(ise3_dataset_fresh{dataset="posture_current"} and on(dataset,provider) (ise3_dataset_provider_active{dataset="posture_current"} == 1))) == 1)))

panels.title: Posture status over time

panels.description: Posture assessments each PSN performed, split by outcome. Uneven distribution is a load-balancing question; a node producing only failures is a node whose posture configuration or connectivity is broken.

targets.expr: (ise3_posture_assessments_by_psn) and on() (((max(ise3_dataset_up{dataset="posture_history"} and on(dataset,provider) (ise3_dataset_provider_active{dataset="posture_history"} == 1))) == 1) and ((max(ise3_dataset_fresh{dataset="posture_history"} and on(dataset,provider) (ise3_dataset_provider_active{dataset="posture_history"} == 1))) == 1))

panels.title: Assessment volume per PSN

panels.description: Live posture status grouped by the operations owner attribute of the network device the endpoint is attached to. This is the panel that turns a compliance number into a list of teams to talk to.

targets.expr: sum by (ops_owner) ((ise3_posture_endpoints{status!~"Compliant|compliant"}) and on() (((max(ise3_dataset_up{dataset="posture_current"} and on(dataset,provider) (ise3_dataset_provider_active{dataset="posture_current"} == 1))) == 1) and ((max(ise3_dataset_fresh{dataset="posture_current"} and on(dataset,provider) (ise3_dataset_provider_active{dataset="posture_current"} == 1))) == 1)))

panels.title: Non-compliance by owner

panels.description: Posture policies with failing results, worst first. A single policy dominating usually means the policy is wrong rather than the fleet — check what it requires before chasing endpoints. Served from the assessment history, which carries the per-policy verdict as its own column; the live MnT breakdown is the fallback where that view is unavailable.

targets.expr: sum by (policy) ((ise3_posture_failing_policies) and on() (((max(ise3_dataset_up{dataset="posture_history"} and on(dataset,provider) (ise3_dataset_provider_active{dataset="posture_history"} == 1))) == 1) and ((max(ise3_dataset_fresh{dataset="posture_history"} and on(dataset,provider) (ise3_dataset_provider_active{dataset="posture_history"} == 1))) == 1))) or sum by (policy) ((ise3_posture_policy_results{result!~"pass|Passed|passed"}) and on() (((max(ise3_dataset_up{dataset="posture_current"} and on(dataset,provider) (ise3_dataset_provider_active{dataset="posture_current"} == 1))) == 1) and ((max(ise3_dataset_fresh{dataset="posture_current"} and on(dataset,provider) (ise3_dataset_provider_active{dataset="posture_current"} == 1))) == 1)))

panels.title: Failing posture policies

panels.description: The individual posture conditions endpoints failed — the specific missing patch, absent process, or out-of-date definition file. The most directly actionable panel here.

targets.expr: (ise3_posture_failed_conditions) and on() (((max(ise3_dataset_up{dataset="posture_history"} and on(dataset,provider) (ise3_dataset_provider_active{dataset="posture_history"} == 1))) == 1) and ((max(ise3_dataset_fresh{dataset="posture_history"} and on(dataset,provider) (ise3_dataset_provider_active{dataset="posture_history"} == 1))) == 1))

panels.title: Failed conditions

panels.description: The requirement level, which a policy hides: a policy rolls its requirements up, so an Audit requirement that failed leaves the policy reading Passed. Mandate is the column that matters — a failed Mandatory requirement is denying access, while Audit and Optional only record. A long list with nothing Mandatory in it means posture is running in observation mode.

targets.expr: (ise3_posture_requirement_results{result!~"Passed|passed|pass"}) and on() (((max(ise3_dataset_up{dataset="posture_current"} and on(dataset,provider) (ise3_dataset_provider_active{dataset="posture_current"} == 1))) == 1) and ((max(ise3_dataset_fresh{dataset="posture_current"} and on(dataset,provider) (ise3_dataset_provider_active{dataset="posture_current"} == 1))) == 1))

panels.title: Failing requirements, by mandate

panels.description: Agent versions across endpoints with a live posture result. Old agents are the usual explanation for a cluster of unassessed or failing endpoints in one part of the estate.

targets.expr: (ise3_posture_agent_version_endpoints) and on() (((max(ise3_dataset_up{dataset="posture_current"} and on(dataset,provider) (ise3_dataset_provider_active{dataset="posture_current"} == 1))) == 1) and ((max(ise3_dataset_fresh{dataset="posture_current"} and on(dataset,provider) (ise3_dataset_provider_active{dataset="posture_current"} == 1))) == 1))

panels.title: Secure Client versions

panels.description: Operating systems among posture-assessed endpoints. Compare against the endpoints dashboard's OS breakdown: an OS present there and absent here is an OS nobody is posturing.

targets.expr: (ise3_posture_endpoints_by_os) and on() (((max(ise3_dataset_up{dataset="posture_current"} and on(dataset,provider) (ise3_dataset_provider_active{dataset="posture_current"} == 1))) == 1) and ((max(ise3_dataset_fresh{dataset="posture_current"} and on(dataset,provider) (ise3_dataset_provider_active{dataset="posture_current"} == 1))) == 1))

panels.title: Operating systems assessed

panels.description: Compliance across the assessment history window rather than the live session list. Diverging from the live figure means the population that is connected right now is not representative of the fleet.

targets.expr: (sum((ise3_posture_assessments{status=~"Compliant|compliant|Pass|passed"}) and on() (((max(ise3_dataset_up{dataset="posture_history"} and on(dataset,provider) (ise3_dataset_provider_active{dataset="posture_history"} == 1))) == 1) and ((max(ise3_dataset_fresh{dataset="posture_history"} and on(dataset,provider) (ise3_dataset_provider_active{dataset="posture_history"} == 1))) == 1)))) / clamp_min((sum((ise3_posture_assessments) and on() (((max(ise3_dataset_up{dataset="posture_history"} and on(dataset,provider) (ise3_dataset_provider_active{dataset="posture_history"} == 1))) == 1) and ((max(ise3_dataset_fresh{dataset="posture_history"} and on(dataset,provider) (ise3_dataset_provider_active{dataset="posture_history"} == 1))) == 1)))), 1)

targets.expr: avg((ise3_session_detail_field_coverage) and on() (((max(ise3_dataset_up{dataset="posture_current"} and on(dataset,provider) (ise3_dataset_provider_active{dataset="posture_current"} == 1))) == 1) and ((max(ise3_dataset_fresh{dataset="posture_current"} and on(dataset,provider) (ise3_dataset_provider_active{dataset="posture_current"} == 1))) == 1)))

targets.expr: (ise3_posture_eligible_endpoints_total) and on() (((max(ise3_dataset_up{dataset="posture_history"} and on(dataset,provider) (ise3_dataset_provider_active{dataset="posture_history"} == 1))) == 1) and ((max(ise3_dataset_fresh{dataset="posture_history"} and on(dataset,provider) (ise3_dataset_provider_active{dataset="posture_history"} == 1))) == 1))

(ise3_endpoints_posture_applicable{applicable="yes"}) and on() (((max(ise3_dataset_up{dataset="endpoint_inventory"} and on(dataset,provider) (ise3_dataset_provider_active{dataset="endpoint_inventory"} == 1))) == 1) and ((max(ise3_dataset_fresh{dataset="endpoint_inventory"} and on(dataset,provider) (ise3_dataset_provider_active{dataset="endpoint_inventory"} == 1))) == 1))

panels.title: Assessment results by policy

panels.description: Purpose, reading order, and where to go next. Kept with the dashboard so the meaning cannot drift away from the panels.

options.content:
**Purpose** — answer whether the fleet is compliant, and separate 'assessed and failing' from 'never assessed at all'.

**Read it in this order**

1. Read compliant share and assessment coverage together — one without the other is misleading.
2. Read **Eligible but unassessed**: invisible endpoints are the real gap.
3. Use failed conditions to get to something actionable.

**When something is red**

- High compliance, low coverage: the number is not trustworthy; fix the agents before reporting it.
- One policy dominating failures: inspect the policy, not the endpoints.
- One PSN producing all failures: continue on the PSN service dashboard.

**Related dashboards** — Triage, Endpoints and devices, PSN service

*Owner: set this to the team that answers the page. Runbook: link it here — a red panel with no runbook is a puzzle, not an alert.*
